*Kusalattika, Cittasampayuttaduka* (Patthana 16.18) is an Abhidhamma text belonging to the *Paṭṭhāna* section of the Pali Tipiṭaka [SuttaCentral]. In the combinatorial matrix of the *Paṭṭhāna*, the text pairs the triad of wholesome, unwholesome, and undetermined phenomena (*kusalattika*) with the dyad regarding phenomena associated with consciousness (*cittasampayuttaduka*) [SuttaCentral]. SuttaCentral catalogs this entry as a leaf text under the acronym Patthana 16.18, without an English translation or external parallels [SuttaCentral].

It also exhibits high textual correspondence with adjacent chapters treating consciousness-related dyads, including *Kusalattika, Cittasaṁsaṭṭhaduka* (Patthana 16.19; longest segment range §0.1–4.1 ↔ §0.1–4.1), *Kusalattika, Cittaduka* (Patthana 16.16), *Kusalattika, Cittasamuṭṭhānaduka* (Patthana 16.20), and *Kusalattika, Cetasikaduka* (Patthana 16.17) [DharmaNexus].
